source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 无锋归鞘，木族叮嘱
title: 无锋归鞘，木族叮嘱
purpose: 承接无锋睹剑伤情后：拓拔野愿将断剑归还并为弄断剑惶恐；白衣女子以无形之力让无锋归入拓拔野右腰绿竹剑鞘；她询问拓拔野族属，叮嘱他收好木族神器；最后目光转向竹笛，引出刹那芳华曲和神农临终重托。画面只做无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕或可读文字。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 人有情 / 剑断情伤 / 断剑归鞘 / 木族神器 / 刹那芳华。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses previous SC10 grief or handover frame to maintain emotional continuity. SH02 uses Tuobaye turnaround or SC10 handover frame to lock right-waist green bamboo sheath and rugged costume. SH03 uses adult Yushiqie reference or SC10 two-character frame to stabilize the white-clothed woman. SH04 uses Tuobaye turnaround or prior grief frame to keep green bamboo flute and Tuobaye reaction clear.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, speech bubbles, musical notes, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.inscription_rule: Do not render visible 神农, 空桑, 木族, 刹那芳华, or any readable Chinese characters. If old marks appear on Wufeng, they must be abstract glow strokes only.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, flute/xiao audio, heartbeat audio, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 既然这把剑原是仙女姐姐的，今日就物归原主吧。
剑断情伤，这也是天意，与你不相干。
公子就将此剑收好，不要轻易出示。
公子又是从何处听得这首刹那芳华曲？
